content.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Edit this original Dreamerie painting into one matching spot-the-difference counterpart. Preserve exact entire landscape frame, library shelves/lightning storage, four-armed purple librarian anatomy and expression, painted grain-free style. Exactly FIVE localized single-object changes: 1 red desk bell lower-right has a tall conical bell body instead of rounded dome, same gold base. 2 the large gold key hanging at librarian right hip has its LOWER tooth pointing left instead of right, preserve upper bow/chain. 3 the lightning bolt emerging from the held teacup bends its LOWEST segment LEFT instead of right, cup unchanged. 4 the teal step stool TOP platform handhold becomes a distinct crescent-shaped slot instead of oval; lower steps untouched. 5 the white quill in front desk inkwell has its pale central shaft split into a clear Y fork near its upper third, outline/blue neighboring quill untouched. These are five separate coherent single-object clues; all other items remain original. No added specks, grain or arbitrary recoloring. Output one full-frame painted image same resolution.
